title: Lists Quiz
description: Test list indexing, append, extend, slicing, pop, and basic sorting.

questions.prompt: What is the index of the first item in a Python list?
questions.explanation: Python lists are zero-indexed.
Index 1 is the second element.

questions.prompt: Negative indices count from the end of a list.
questions.explanation: Index -1 is the last item, -2 the second to last, and so on.
append adds a single element to the end of the list.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between append and extend?
options: append adds one item; extend adds each item from an iterable
extend adds one nested list only
questions.explanation: extend([2,3]) adds 2 and 3; append([2,3]) adds the whole list as one element.
Slicing includes the start index and stops before the end index.

questions.prompt: list.pop() removes and returns the last item by default.
questions.explanation: pop() with no argument removes the final element; pop(i) removes at index i.
sort() orders the list in place ascending by default.
The outer list contains one element: an empty inner list.
extend unpacks the iterable and appends each element.
-1 refers to the last element.

questions.prompt: Lists are mutable—you can change, add, and remove items after creation.
questions.explanation: Unlike tuples, lists support in-place modification.
pop(0) removes and returns the element at index 0.
A step of 2 takes every other element starting at index 0.
[] or list() both construct empty lists.

questions.prompt: After `x = [1, 2]` then `y = x` then `y.append(3)`, what is `x`?
questions.explanation: y and x refer to the same list object, so mutating y affects x.

questions.prompt: sorted([3, 1, 2]) returns a new sorted list without changing the original.
questions.explanation: sorted() is non-destructive; sort() modifies in place.

options: A new list is created only in nums[1]
questions.explanation: Lists support item assignment by index.
+ concatenates lists into a new list.

questions.prompt: Which method removes the first occurrence of a value?
questions.explanation: remove(value) deletes by value; pop() deletes by index.
